$comment: Observer check -> playbook requirement row. status: enforced (dispatches tickets), advisory (measured, not dispatched), not-a-website-change (routes to a source owner), needs-row (no requirement yet). 0.3: the playbook brand-visual check (tests/page-check.mjs, not a production observer check) is listed under checks with status advisory and under coverageOutsideObserver site.brand.visual. 0.4 (2026-09-24): every name in registry/observer-checks.json is listed; status retired means spec/check-rows.json retires the check (reason there); spec/check-bundle.generated.json is the compiled row per check and supersedes status here for dispatch. 0.5 (2026-09-24, filer review fixes): campus-application-finalsite-redirect (campus.resources.apply, enforced), campus-page-email-source-sync (campus.facts.contact, enforced), campus-grade-source-incomplete (campus.facts.grades, advisory: telemetry until the grade-source decision), route-screenshot-capture and route-font-readiness (site.loop.health, loop-health channel) added. 0.6 (2026-09-24): dedupeAliases lists, per observer check, the older check ids (tests/page-check.mjs ids such as cta-links-resolve and cta-hidden-everywhere, the sweep agents' campus.resources.* and campus.controls.* ids) and title patterns under which a ticket for the same defect was filed before the check bundle; agent/file-observer-findings.mjs treats an open ticket on the same page carrying one of them as the same ticket and files nothing new.

requirements.site.header.rendered: Header template renders with its stylesheet, logo, navigation, Contact Us; footer renders.
requirements.site.layout.viewport: No horizontal overflow beyond 160px, header overlap under 48px/25%, no clipped text, CTAs inside viewport on desktop 1440x1000 and mobile 390x844.
requirements.site.layout.images: Visible images render; staff photos do not clip faces.
requirements.site.layout.console: Under 20 console errors on critical routes.
requirements.site.brand.copy: MacKenzie's recorded copy rules; four held items untouched.
requirements.site.identity.sister-brand: No sister-brand names in page-owned content except the Brownsville/Nova exception.
requirements.site.identity.other-campus: No other campus referenced in image names, alt text, links, packets, calendars, schema.
requirements.site.seasonal.window: Seasonal CTAs only inside the approved window; launch statements name month/season and year.
requirements.site.search.indexable: robots reachable, sitemap populated, critical routes indexable with canonical, no duplicate titles/canonicals, valid JSON-LD, Googlebot parity.
requirements.site.search.ai-files: AI discovery files reachable and non-empty.
requirements.site.search.schema: Campus School schema with URL, address, coordinates within 1 mile of source.
requirements.site.claims.evidence: Statistics and named-entity claims exist in the claim registry with evidence.
requirements.site.events.sync: Public HubSpot events appear on /upcoming-events/ and the campus strip within 4 hours of becoming public; past events never file; registration links resolve; facts match; sister-brand events excluded.
requirements.site.map.integrity: Maps render; each program once with correct label, status, coordinates, destination; pre-announcement pins route to Community; no scroll trap.
requirements.site.community.routing: Community destinations use campus=<verified Community slug>, joined by exact HubSpot program id to a visible Community record; unknown or ambiguous mappings fail closed.
requirements.site.loop.health: Source providers and snapshots healthy (not a website change).
requirements.campus.hero.identity: H1 and subtitle name this campus; page title, schema, nav, sitemap agree.
requirements.campus.intro.status-sentence: Intro status sentence matches the lifecycle state (Open: "is open and enrolling."; Announced: named month/season and year).
requirements.campus.intro.media: Intro card slot shows approved open-state media (card or video) for Open campuses; no launch-era media on Open campuses.
requirements.campus.facts.grades: Grade range on hero, intro, Locations card, schema, meta matches HubSpot/Operations.
requirements.campus.facts.contact: Phone, address, email, coordinates match the source.
requirements.campus.facts.tuition: Tuition on page and Locations card match the source.
requirements.campus.resources.packet: Info packet CTA present when an approved current packet exists; destination public, correct campus and year.
requirements.campus.resources.calendar: Calendar CTA reachable and campus-specific when required.
requirements.campus.resources.booking: Book a Call / Book a Tour reachable and campus-specific.
requirements.campus.resources.apply: Apply CTA present for Open/Announced with HubSpot admission_link, reachable and campus-specific.
requirements.campus.team.roster: Staff cards match the roster: names, titles, bios, headshots; faces not clipped.
requirements.campus.events.strip: Only this campus's events (plus approved national events) render; canceled/private accept no registration.
requirements.campus.page.reachable: Canonical URL loads 200, in sitemap, canonical tag matches, no redirect to another campus.
requirements.site.brand.visual: Official Alpha visual brand (spec/brand-visual.json): Montserrat on every text element, no never-row contrast pair, backgrounds and headlines from the palette, an unmodified canonical logo file; word rules stay MacKenzie's.

brand-visual.note: playbook tests/page-check.mjs (tests/brand-visual.mjs), not a production observer check; fail-severity findings are warn while spec/brand-visual.json check.enforcement.mode is advisory; INFO-only in the copy and launch-copy doneWhen; files as observer-brand-visual

dedupeAliases.$comment: Older ticket ids and title shapes for the same defect on the same page, per observer check. checkIds are matched exactly (case-insensitive) against a ticket's customFields.checkId, check and observerCheck; titlePatterns are case-insensitive regular expressions against the ticket title. A match counts only on one of the group's pages (ticket url, customFields.pageUrl, or an alpha.school URL in the description).
